resources.string: Bubble Keyboard is your current keyboard
How see-through the bubble is while it rests; it turns solid when you open it
How far keys grow and slide out from under your finger in a bloom
Rotate the letter bloom to fit
Turns the letters toward the middle of the screen when the bubble sits near an edge
Tap here, then tap the bubble

Tap the bubble to open the ring. Arrows and backspace repeat while held. Hold abc for letters, space for punctuation, enter for numbers: slide to a key and let go to type it, or slide back to cancel. Keep holding abc still for a second to toggle caps lock. Tap the center to fold up, drag it to move, long-press it to switch keyboards.
